summary: Gene-signature donor ROC-AUC 0.9792, Brier 0.0547, age Spearman -0.8767 across 14 donors.
allowed_claim: Kaile v1.1 is an internally supported frozen donor-level young-state similarity scorer.
prohibited_claim: Validated aging clock; safety score; causal rejuvenation; cell-level independent inference.

summary: Primary nested LOMO AUC 0.979, all-age rho -0.633, old-only rho 0.655, library-size rho -0.521.
allowed_claim: Zihan v2.1 is a frozen FACS young-old cohort-state separator with reproducible binary separation.
prohibited_claim: Validated continuous aging clock; externally validated universal MSC score; technical-confounding-free model.

summary: Donor age Spearman -0.838 in Kaile packaged 16-donor TMS Droplet trajectory sensitivity analysis.
allowed_claim: Expected within-model age direction carries across assay as sensitivity evidence.
prohibited_claim: Independent external validation; proof of assay-independent model validity; direct numeric comparability.
notes: Do not combine this 16-donor packaged trajectory with the 12-donor shared comparison subset.

summary: Both models preserve Young-Old direction in cleaned FACS and the 12-donor local Droplet subset; score units and estimands differ. Bootstrap intervals do not establish an overall winner.
allowed_claim: Frozen-model directional, ranking, and cross-assay sensitivity comparison only.
prohibited_claim: Model winner selection; ensemble; mathematical equivalence; independent external validation; validated continuous aging clock; v2.1 relabelled as v3.
notes: Kaile has more consistent descriptive age-ordering point estimates in some metrics. Concordance can be driven partly by shared Young-Old separation; neither model is proven technically independent.

summary: Young control minus aged control +0.0359; aged SOKM minus aged control -0.1486; minimum gene overlap 0.942.
allowed_claim: GSE176206 SOKM did not move toward the Kaile young reference under this score.
prohibited_claim: Accelerated aging; broad harm; safety; clinical age; treatment efficacy.

primary_statistical_unit: known animal paired contrasts; n=3 per age group
summary: Aged SOKM reduced Youth Score, MSC identity, and ECM/collagen; baseline/Col11a1 states decreased while reprogramming states increased; global cell-cycle activation is method-sensitive.
allowed_claim: state_remodeling_dominant interpretation for GSE176206 MSC SOKM response.
prohibited_claim: Accelerated aging; clinical harm; tumourigenicity; validated safety; treating 20,661 cells as independent replicates.
notes: Known animals are primary; unknown cells are sensitivity only.

summary: Contextual identity-loss risk increased, inflammation/SASP risk decreased, and abnormal-proliferation/DDR was method-sensitive in the aged integrated assessment.
allowed_claim: Contextual risk modules may support biological interpretation.
prohibited_claim: Kei final Risk Score; safety score; cancer diagnosis; averaged total risk.
notes: Do not equate with Kei final Risk.

summary: Kei parameters are registered from team instruction and master gene list was audited; scoring script/config and threshold scope are TBD.
allowed_claim: Method can be tracked as frozen pending code verification.
prohibited_claim: Final GSE risk values; safety conclusion; single averaged risk score.
notes: Axis labels and threshold scope require owner confirmation.

primary_statistical_unit: animal TBD; current analysis described as unpaired
summary: Preliminary visual: gene coverage reported >95%; each point is one animal; SOKM lower Dedifferentiation and Inflammation; Genomic Stress slight or mixed.

summary: Raw donor LOO 11/14 p=0.050; after detected-gene regression 8/14 p=0.531; matched-depth band 10/14 p=0.094.
allowed_claim: Old-young Geneformer axis cannot be validated on this cohort; age and transcript complexity are inseparable here.
prohibited_claim: Geneformer fails generally; perturbation ranking is interpretable; axis is validated.

summary: Seven candidate factor table is pipeline output with small shifts and internal inconsistency; superseded by axis diagnostic.
prohibited_claim: Formal factor ranking; candidate selection; Youth/Risk scorer input.
notes: Geneformer output is not predicted expression.

primary_statistical_unit: known animal paired contrasts; n=3 per age group
summary: Both separately run frozen models show negative SOKM-minus-control direction in all valid young and aged animals; aggregate decrease reflects both state redistribution and selected within-state remodeling.
allowed_claim: Model-sensitivity and biological follow-up; no raw-magnitude comparison or merged score.
prohibited_claim: New model validation; Kaile magnitude proves correctness; uniform accelerated aging; factor-specific OSKM subset inference.
notes: Reprogramming states are mostly SOKM-dominant; baseline/Col11a1-like states include some matched within-state negative shifts.

primary_statistical_unit: donor for LOO; cell for confound correlation
summary: 256-token same-cell experiment retained all 815 cells and dropped 0 old cells: fixed LOO 13/14, p=0.001, confound r=0.619; variable-length control 11/14, p=0.050, r=0.691.
allowed_claim: Fixed token length partially reduces the detected-gene confound and improves cell-level donor separation; input sequence length is one contributor.
prohibited_claim: Fully deconfounded Geneformer axis; validated perturbation ranking; biological aging proof; 1536-token 14/14 as clean validation.
notes: Residual confound remains approximately r >= 0.5. Long token cutoffs preferentially remove old cells; the reported 1536-token 14/14 result is selection-biased. Axis-length PDF and raw sweep are missing locally.

allowed_claim: The cell-level benefit from fixed token length did not survive aggregation to the donor inference unit.
prohibited_claim: Pseudobulk rescues Geneformer; donor-level Geneformer aging axis is validated.
notes: Raw pseudobulk diagnostic script/config and results are pending Jia Qi.
